axes: three.js: +Y up, front of each prop faces +Z; origin on the ground at the foot centre; metres
vertexColours: COLOR_0 carries hue, soot, dirt and wear: keep material.vertexColors = true

props.name: tabun
props.label: השלמה דרמטית
props.basis: Tabun: BE 3.4 "not verified" for the period; VL 1.4 tabun in yard and rooms at the Rishon LeZion farm (coast, c.300 BCE, agreed) -> hills 160s inference. Lid and ash heap: design.
props.place: yard, one per house that bakes (10 of 14 today); 1.5-3 m from a wall, downwind of the door

props.name: tabun_shelter
props.label: השלמה דרמטית
props.basis: Rubble shelter with lintel and brush-and-earth roof after the photo "Village oven" (1898-1914 only). No period source.
props.place: over the tabun in about half the yards that have one; back against the yard wall

props.name: jar_store_a
props.label: השלמה דרמטית
props.basis: Storage jars: agreed in quantity at the El'ad farm 15 km from Modi'in, made locally (VL 3, Nagorsky). SHAPE not checked against any typology (none read): tall bag form is design.
props.place: inside rooms along the back wall (3-6), 1-3 beside doors, bedded 6-10 cm into the earth or leaning

props.name: jar_store_b
props.label: השלמה דרמטית
props.basis: As jar_store_a; wider ovoid variant, shape is design.
props.place: with jar_store_a; mix 2:1

props.name: jar_broken
props.label: השלמה דרמטית
props.basis: Broken jar (lower half) and sherds: design, for refuse heaps and yard corners.
props.place: refuse heaps, beside a wall; 0-1 per yard

props.name: jug_water
props.label: היסק
props.basis: VL 1.4 water drawing: method not read; dossier default "clay jar and rope", carried on shoulder or head (inference). Shape is design.
props.place: at every cistern mouth (with rope), by doors; carried by women and girls

props.name: cookpot_a
props.label: השלמה דרמטית
props.basis: Cooking: VL 1.4 women cook in the yard (inference); RE 7 table and work vessels at Maresha (Idumean). Shape is design; soot is the point.
props.place: beside the tabun or a hearth of three stones; in the family room

props.name: cookpot_b
props.label: השלמה דרמטית
props.basis: Smaller cooking pot; as cookpot_a.
props.place: with cookpot_a

props.name: bowl
props.label: השלמה דרמטית
props.basis: Open bowl; shape is design.
props.place: by the quern, on mats, by the oven

props.name: quern_saddle
props.label: היסק
props.basis: VL 1.4: grinding tools at the Rishon farm, type not given; rotary quern DISPUTED for the date -> dossier default saddle quern on the yard floor, woman kneeling. Never a rotary quern.
props.place: yard floor near the room door, one per house; a bowl and basket beside it

props.name: loom
props.label: השלמה דרמטית
props.basis: Loom weights by dozens at Kh. Asad (Galilee, later 2nd c.) and Maresha (VL 1.4, agreed there). Warp-weighted loom "strong inference, not verified for Judea 160"; loom in the yard listed as dramatization (VL 1.6). Weight shape is design.
props.place: leaning against a sunny yard wall or a room wall by the door, 2-4 in the village

props.name: spindle
props.label: היסק
props.basis: Spindle with stone whorl: 8 basalt whorls 8-18 g at the Rishon farm (VL 1.4, agreed on the coast); hills 160 inference.
props.place: in a basket by the loom, or in a woman's hand

props.name: mat_reed
props.label: השלמה דרמטית
props.basis: Reed mat: dramatization in the village kit (BE 11.1 has the yard and room only by inference).
props.place: room floors (1-2), yard by the door; drying produce on roofs

props.name: mat_palm
props.label: השלמה דרמטית
props.basis: Plaited palm mat: design.
props.place: family room, yard where women sit

props.name: mat_rolled
props.label: השלמה דרמטית
props.basis: Rolled mat: design.
props.place: against a room wall, on roofs

props.name: basket_round
props.label: השלמה דרמטית
props.basis: Coiled basket: design (no basketry read).
props.place: yards, rooms, threshing floor; 2-4 per yard

props.name: basket_tall
props.label: השלמה דרמטית
props.basis: Tall coiled basket: design.
props.place: by doors, by the oven (dung/brush), at the press

props.name: tray_winnow
props.label: היסק
props.basis: Winnowing: "fork / shovel / basket to the wind" (VL 3, secondary [Thr], less doubt). Flat coiled tray is design.
props.place: threshing floor (2-3), yards

props.name: load_grain
props.label: השלמה דרמטית
props.basis: Heap of grain to sit in a basket or tray, or on the threshing floor.
props.place: inside basket_round / tray_winnow; scale 0.9-1.2

props.name: ard
props.label: היסק
props.basis: Ploughing with oxen (Ben Sira 38:25-26, VL 3). Light wooden ard with iron share: "not verified; inference" (VL 3). Form is design.
props.place: leaning on a yard wall or lying by the field edge; 2-3 in the village

props.name: yoke
props.label: היסק
props.basis: Yoke for a pair of oxen: follows from ploughing with oxen (VL 3). Form is design.
props.place: with the ard, hung on a peg or lying by it

props.name: fork_winnow
props.label: היסק
props.basis: Winnowing fork: VL 3 ("fork / shovel / basket", secondary; Caesarea floor threshed with forks). Form is design.
props.place: threshing floor (2-4), leaning on walls

props.name: shovel_winnow
props.label: היסק
props.basis: Winnowing shovel: VL 3 as the fork. Form is design.
props.place: threshing floor, beside grain heaps

props.name: sledge_threshing
props.label: השלמה דרמטית
props.basis: Threshing sledge (morag): biblical, wood (2 Sam 24:22, not opened); VL 3 lists "threshing with a sledge" as dramatization. Stone teeth underneath: design.
props.place: threshing floor only, 1; or leaning on the wall nearest the floor

props.name: sickle
props.label: מוסכם
props.basis: Iron sickle and mattock in the "frozen" farm storeroom at Kh. Asad (later 2nd c., Galilee; VL 3). Form is design.
props.place: on a wall peg, in a basket, in reapers' hands

props.name: mattock
props.label: מוסכם
props.basis: As the sickle (Kh. Asad). Form is design.
props.place: leaning by the yard gate, on roofs during repair

props.name: waterskin
props.label: השלמה דרמטית
props.basis: Goatskin water bag: not in any dossier (VL default for water is jar and rope). Pure dramatization.
props.place: hung at a door or on a shepherd; sparingly (0-3 in the village)

props.name: cistern_mouth
props.label: מוסכם
props.basis: Rock-cut cistern mouth about 1x1 m with thick pale plaster (BE 3.1 Horvat Ashun, agreed; BE 11.1 small cistern ~1 m mouth). Kerb blocks and cover slab: inference/design.
props.place: replaces cisternMouth() in the yards that have one (40 %, always the large and the family house)

props.name: roller_roof
props.label: היסק
props.basis: Stone roof roller re-compacting the earth roof after the first rains: Nazareth Village reconstruction (BE 3.3, inference, "no tiles").
props.place: on one roof in three (replaces roller()); never in a yard

props.name: ladder_a
props.label: השלמה דרמטית
props.basis: Pole ladder with lashed rungs (2.6 m): design; outside stone stairs are the dossier's access (inference).
props.place: to roofs without a stair, 1 in 3 houses

props.name: ladder_b
props.label: השלמה דרמטית
props.basis: Longer pole ladder (3.4 m): design.
props.place: against the tallest rooms; olive harvest

props.name: brush_stack
props.label: השלמה דרמטית
props.basis: Cut thorn and maquis brush for the oven: design (tabun itself unverified).
props.place: beside each tabun, on some roofs

props.name: log_stack
props.label: השלמה דרמטית
props.basis: Split olive and oak wood: design.
props.place: against a room wall, 1 per 2 houses

props.name: trough_stone
props.label: השלמה דרמטית
props.basis: Stone trough: animals kept at home "not verified" (BE 3.4); plastered rock-cut vats agreed at Ashun (BE 3.1). Trough is design.
props.place: in the pen corner (replaces trough()), by the cistern for the flock
